## Texts and drawings (5)

- **E0926** (text, likely): 嘉庆十三年 谕旨 on 西爽村 (as quoted in S220). 嘉庆十三年 1808 · S220 section 一; archive not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 西爽村着仍称绮春园宫门（即绮春园西宫门），嗣后一切称谓书写，俱不得再有西爽村字样。
  The name 西爽村 is to be dropped in favour of the west gate of the garden. The bracket is the modern author's gloss. S220 puts 西爽村 in the area of the later 延英论道 QC28: a position hint for QC28 near QC61.
- **E0925** (poem, likely): 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 西爽村 诗序 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up · S220 section 一; primary not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 西爽村秋原如画，遥缅凤城，楼阁隐见浮岚暖翠中。公平旦趋朝，每由园西角门入左掖垣。
  West of the garden, open autumn fields with a view to the capital; Fuheng left by the west corner gate for court. S220's bracket gloss is removed.
- **E0786** (description, sure): 贾珺: 绮春园龙王庙 from a Yangshi Lei drawing. 2012 · S47 p.117 · S47. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2018/06/15/u5b23730ae0e5a.pdf
  The dragon-king temple stands in the middle of the 延英论道 area in its own court, water on all four sides, with a one-bay east-facing gate hall and a three-bay main hall. Answers Q11 for QC24: it belongs inside QC28. S220 agrees in placing 龙王庙 in the later 延英论道 area.
- **E0722** (description, likely): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 含辉楼. 2020 edition · v4 p.317 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=320
  Given to Prince Yongxuan about 1773 as 含晖园, to Princess Zhuangjing in 1801, returned in 1811 as 南园, when 联辉楼 was moved here from 西爽村. Main tower two storeys of seven bays, with a riding track 撤马道 south of it and 招凉榭, a five-bay open hall, on an islet. Its gates are 环翠 and the city-style south gate with Jiaqing's plaques 护松扉 and 排青幌. North of it lie 清夏斋 and 延英论道.
- **E0800** (plan, sure): 从《春和园纪游诗》: 延英论道. post n.d. · NLC 样101-7 · S337. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/143ef8cac193488089ad8d164e2ec3d5.htm
  NLC plan 样101-7 labels only one building in the small garden west of 清夏斋: 延英论道, three bays, on the south shore of the east water. A sibling paper puts the earlier 西爽村 here.
